title: Setup: the Register SSO Provider form has no Token, Authorization or JWKS URL fields, so a Google-style IdP still cannot register from the UI
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1NJYFGVi2FRztyBNo

Filing gate: ① a defect owed by landed work (#33314, Acceptance notes), with a named location: the Setup form `register_sso_provider` action in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts`.
Reader: server area A1 (auth and identity) of the area-lease pilot #33059, by an `os-dev` subagent; `priority:p2`.
Dedupe (open and closed): `is:issue register_sso_provider tokenEndpoint` 3 hits (#33197 the bridge half, closed by #33314; #32297 the userinfo field, closed; #8009 secret storage, closed); `is:issue SSO form token endpoint` 78 loose hits, none for the form's missing endpoint fields.

## 维护者速读

托管环境里,像 Google 这样 token 地址和 issuer 不在同一个域名的 IdP,注册时会被拒并提示「填 tokenEndpoint」。#33314 已让 API 入口收这个字段,但 Setup 里的「注册 SSO 提供方」表单仍然只有 Userinfo URL,没有 token、授权、密钥地址的输入框,所以不会写代码的管理员在界面上仍然注册不了 Google。

## Business reason

An administrator of a hosted environment who connects Google (or any IdP whose token, authorization or key endpoint is on another origin than its issuer) from Setup is refused with a message telling them to name `tokenEndpoint`, and the form has no such field. The only way through is the API door, which a no-code administrator does not use. Without the fields, Google SSO stays unreachable from the product UI.

## Reach

Read on `main` after #33314: the form's params are `providerId`, `issuer`, `domain`, `clientId`, `clientSecret`, `discoveryEndpoint`, `userInfoEndpoint`, `skipUserInfo`, `scopes` and the claim mappings; the bridge (`register-sso-provider.ts`) now passes `tokenEndpoint`, `authorizationEndpoint` and `jwksEndpoint` when given. The staging refusal for Google's token endpoint is measured in #33197.

## Expected

1. The form offers optional Token URL, Authorization URL and JWKS URL fields (type `url`), passed to the bridge under the names it takes, with help text saying when to name them (the registration refusal for an untrusted endpoint).
2. The generated object translations are regenerated.
3. A test pins that each field reaches the bridge's `oidcConfig`.

## Also owed (cloud, one line)

The cloud per-environment auth handler has to serve `GET /sso/get-provider` in-process for the domain-verification answer to carry the registered domain (#33314 Acceptance notes). That is a cloud change and is not part of this card.
